tokens.npc_dota_hero_windrunner_bio: The western forests guard their secrets well. One of these is Lyralei, master archer of the wood, and favored godchild of the wind.  Known now as Windranger, Lyralei's family was killed in a storm on the night of her birth--their house blown down by the gale, contents scattered to the winds. Only the newborn survived among the debris field of death and destruction.  In the quiet after the storm, the wind itself took notice of the lucky infant crying in the grass. The wind pitied the child and so lifted her into the sky and deposited her on a doorstep in a neighboring village.  In the years that followed, the wind returned occasionally to the child's life, watching from a distance while she honed her skills.  Now, after many years of training, Windranger fires her arrows true to their targets.  She moves with blinding speed, as if hastened by a wind ever at her back.  With a flurry of arrows, she slaughters her enemies, having become, nearly, a force of nature herself.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_windrunner_hype: Evasive and swift, the nimble Windranger is always seeking the right angle to attack. Whether she's clearing the way with a draw of her deadly powershot, or shackling enemies together to pepper them with arrows, she's always on the move.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Charges her bow up briefly for a single powerful shot. The longer the charge, the potent the arrow fired.

The arrow damages and slows all enemy units along its path. Reduces damage by a factor per enemy unit hit.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
The Powershot arrow instant kills enemy heroes below a certain max health threshold corresponding to its channel time.

The more units the Powershot hits, the less effective the instant kill threshold.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Powershot: Movement speed reduced by x%.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{hi|Windranger}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} [[File:Dota2 Pto.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 toP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]]
** Affects units up to {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Powershot value1}}+{{#var:Powershot value2}}}} range away with the arrow travel distance and damage radius.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
*** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
**** Grants the following [[flying vision]] bonuses:
***** A non-lingering {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 400-radius vision as the projectile travels in line {{Code|OP}}.
***** A 3.34-second {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 400-radius vision at the projectile's final location, point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] .
*** {{Symbol|Trees}}
**** [[Trees]] within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 50-radius of the projectile are destroyed as it travels in line {{Code|OP}}.

* The ability values have two components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|a|up}}
*** The values increase incrementally per {{M|channeling}} {{M|server tick}}, over {{#expr:trunc({{#var:Powershot value3}}/{{G|tick rate}})}} instances.
**** Increases the total {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} by {{calc|v1/{{#var:Powershot value3}}*{{G|tick rate}} round2|v1={{#var:Powershot value4}}}} per interval.
**** Increases the total {{M|movement speed}} slow by {{calc|v1/{{#var:Powershot value3}}*{{G|tick rate}} round3|v1={{#var:Powershot value6}}|%}} per interval.
**** {{cf|talnotes}}
***** Increases the enemy max {{M|health}} as {{M|instant kill}} threshold value by {{Code|{{ValueColor||{{#var:Powershot type1 value1}}|tal|x}} + {{ValueColor||{{calc|({{#var:Powershot type1 value2}}-{{#var:Powershot type1 value1}})*{{G|tick rate}} round5|%}}|tal|x}}}} per interval.
***** Therefore, the ability no longer instant kills after hitting {{ValueColor||{{calc|ceil(ln(1/v1)/ln({{#var:Powershot value5}}))|v1={{#var:Powershot type1 value1}}}}|25tal}} to {{ValueColor||{{calc|ceil(ln(1/v1)/ln({{#var:Powershot value5}}))|v1={{#var:Powershot type1 value2}}}}|25tal}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] The damage applied per unit is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|PowershotDmg {{=}} MaxDmg × ({{#var:Powershot value5}} + {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{Show|T|Windranger|v2l}}/100}}|tal|x}}) ^ perEnemyHit}}
**** {{cf|talnotes}} Hence, the {{ValueColor||Powershot damage reducing|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2l}} causes Powershot '''not''' to reduce its damage per enemy hit.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The ability effects are applied as follows:
**# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
**# {{cf|talnotes}} Checks and applies an additional {{Code|Current[[HP|Health]] {{=}} [[Spell Damage|SpellDmg]]}} damage instance if the affected enemys' {{M|current health}} is below the threshold.
**#* The following sources prevent affected enemy units from being instant killed:
**#** {{Symbol|bonus db-all}} {{Symbol|bonus db-mag}}
**#*** [[Barrier]] sources.
**#*** Explicitly {{A|Templar Assassin|Refraction}}, if the current hp + barrier is higher than the damage.
**#** The following {{M|damage negation}} sources:
**#*** {{A|Abaddon|Borrowed Time}}, {{A|Oracle|False Promise}}.
**#** [[Min health]] sources (e.g. {{A|Dazzle|Shallow Grave}}).
**# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|windrunner_powershot_slow}}

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus cas}}
*** The ability's [[cast range]] has the following properties:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|CastRange {{=}} Hero[[Attack Range|AtkRange]]}}
**** Not affected by cast range sources.
**** Affected by {{M|attack range}} sources of the same range-type as the caster, except {{A|Hurricane Pike|Hurricane Thrust}}.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Cannot be cast on the following enemy units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|windrunner_focusfire}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Applies the following ability effects on self upon her {{M|attack point}}:
**** Grants the bonus {{M|attack speed}}.
**** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}}
***** Allows Windranger to move while the ability issues auto-attack orders on the latest {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy within her {{M|attack range}}.
***** The following orders do not pause the auto-attack component:

data.name: npc_dota_hero_windrunner
data.bio_loc: The western forests guard their secrets well. One of these is Lyralei, master archer of the wood, and favored godchild of the wind.  Known now as Windranger, Lyralei's family was killed in a storm on the night of her birth--their house blown down by the gale, contents scattered to the winds. Only the newborn survived among the debris field of death and destruction.  In the quiet after the storm, the wind itself took notice of the lucky infant crying in the grass. The wind pitied the child and so lifted her into the sky and deposited her on a doorstep in a neighboring village.  In the years that followed, the wind returned occasionally to the child's life, watching from a distance while she honed her skills.  Now, after many years of training, Windranger fires her arrows true to their targets.  She moves with blinding speed, as if hastened by a wind ever at her back.  With a flurry of arrows, she slaughters her enemies, having become, nearly, a force of nature herself.
data.hype_loc: Evasive and swift, the nimble Windranger is always seeking the right angle to attack. Whether she's clearing the way with a draw of her deadly powershot, or shackling enemies together to pepper them with arrows, she's always on the move.
data.npe_desc_loc: Fires swift flurry of arrows at a single target

abilities.name: windrunner_shackleshot
abilities.desc_loc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
abilities.lore_loc: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
notes_loc: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
facets_loc: Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.

abilities.name: windrunner_powershot
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
abilities.lore_loc: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.
notes_loc: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
facets_loc: Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.

abilities.name: windrunner_windrun
abilities.desc_loc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

abilities.name: windrunner_gale_force
abilities.desc_loc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
abilities.lore_loc: At last Lyralei has learned to call upon the might of her true birthright.

abilities.name: windrunner_focusfire
abilities.desc_loc: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
abilities.lore_loc: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.
notes_loc: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
facets_loc: Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.

abilities.name: windrunner_tailwind
abilities.desc_loc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
abilities.scepter_loc: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
